title: Interactive inbox: adj inbox -i
lead: Add adj inbox -i: a line-mode walk through the open questions, oldest first, where the owner decides, rejects, withdraws or skips each one, with a rationale, without retyping IDs and option labels.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** a full-screen TUI or curses; HTML output; a web server (C09); -i with --all (cross-repo deciding) or with --json; amend or supersede from the walk; any change to what decide/reject/withdraw validate.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Listed in the Later tier to speed up batch answering. Owner decisions 2026-10-18: a line-mode TUI, invoked as adj inbox -i (not a new command), standard library only (bufio on stdin, no terminal raw mode), owner-only like decide: the agent snippet must not suggest it. For each open record, oldest first as adj inbox orders them: print the record as adj inbox does, then prompt for an action: decide by option label, decide with free text, reject, withdraw, skip, quit; decide/reject/withdraw then prompt for the rationale (--why), required and not blank. Writes go through commands.Decide / Reject / Withdraw so validation, history and decided_by ($ADJ_DECIDED_BY, or --by) are the same as the one-shot commands.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- internal/cli/inbox.go (+ test): -i (and --interactive if C32 wants a long form), --by NAME for decided_by; -i with --json, --all or an argument exits 2.
- internal/cli/inbox_interactive.go (new, + test) or internal/commands: the walk loop reading from the invocation's stdin and writing prompts to stdout, errors to stderr; keep it testable with scripted stdin.
- internal/render/inbox.go: reuse the per-record block from InboxText for one record.
- README.md, PROJECT.md (Commands; Later: drop the TUI line), AGENTS.md (inbox entry: -i, owner-only), CHANGELOG.md (## Unreleased).
- internal/commands/ai.md: do not add -i (owner-only). ai_test must stay green.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Red first, scripted stdin, stores in t.TempDir():
- Two open records; script 'decide label a' + rationale for the first and 'skip' for the second: the first is decided with decision a, rationale as typed, decided_by from --by or ADJ_DECIDED_BY, one decide history entry; the second stays open; exit 0.
- Free-text decide, reject and withdraw each move the record as the one-shot commands would (compare the resulting record with one made by adj decide/reject/withdraw on a copy).
- An unknown option label or a blank rationale re-prompts (does not write, does not abort the walk).
- quit stops at once and leaves the rest open; EOF on stdin behaves as quit (exit 0, nothing half-written).
- A record that changed status under the walk (decided by another process between display and write) reports the error from commands.Decide on stderr and continues (exit 1 at the end, or as C32 decides).
- Empty inbox: prints nothing, exit 0.
- -i --json, -i --all and -i with an argument exit 2.
- Prompts and summary line (e.g. '2 decided, 1 rejected, 3 skipped') are pinned by a golden test.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Decide under C32 and record as slicer notes on S19: the action keys and prompt wording (recommend one-letter keys: d=decide by option, t=decide with text, r=reject, w=withdraw, s=skip, q=quit, ?=help), whether decide by option asks for the label or offers numbered options, the end summary line, and the exit code when a write failed during the walk (recommend 1).
2. Red tests, then the loop; call commands.Decide/Reject/Withdraw, never write records directly.
3. Docs as in Files.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- . scripts/env.sh; go test ./...; go vet ./...; GOOS=windows go vet ./...; gofmt -l cmd internal prints nothing.
- go build -o .cache/bin/adj ./cmd/adj; in a temp repo under .cache/tmp/s19-check (adj init, two adj ask), pipe a script into adj inbox -i --root <tmp> and confirm the records with adj show; never run -i against this repo's decisions/.
- .cache/bin/adj lint --root . is clean; mutation check each new test; slicer check --json is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree .worktrees/s19 on branch s19. The orchestrator commits on s19 after VERDICT: PASS and slicer done; no push, no merge; no AI attribution.
